role_title.description: The advertised title of the open role, as shown on the careers page.

location.description: The role's location string exactly as posted (may be 'Remote', a city, or 'Remote - City').

job_url.description: Direct URL to the individual job posting.

department.description: Internal department/team the role belongs to (e.g. Engineering, Sales). Reserved for a later self-heal demo - not extracted in v1.

employment_type.description: Full-time / Part-time / Contract / Intern. Reserved for a later self-heal demo - not extracted in v1.

date_posted.description: Date the role was posted, as a string in the source's own format. Reserved for a later self-heal demo - not extracted in v1.
